title: A/R PDF prints the as-of date you picked, late in the day too
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-03 Evening Print.
  • The test is run in the evening at {Location-A}'s local time, when the date in UTC is already tomorrow, and this computer's clock is set to {Location-A}'s time zone.
    For example: after 6 pm at a location on Mountain Time (UTC-6 in summer, UTC-7 in winter).
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Check that the date chip shows today's date.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the PDF and read its as-of line and its row order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "As of: " and today's date at {Location-A}.
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads (A/R has an Export menu, no Print button).
  • Step 3: the as-of line reads "As of " and that same date: three-letter month, the day without a leading zero, four-digit year (for example "As of Oct 5, 2026"), not tomorrow's date; the PDF prints the on-screen order.

The date is the location's own date: the tech plan says the as-of line uses the location's time zone, which is what fixes today's next-day date.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • What changes for existing users: “A/R's Print button becomes the Export menu; its PDF prints the on-screen order and the as-of date the user picked (today it can print the next day's date).”
  • S3-R4: “Each export states the as-of date the user picked: the PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", the CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (format: three-letter month, day, four-digit year).”
  • S3-R3: “The PDF and the CSV contain exactly the rows on screen for the chosen as-of date, customer or vendor and locations, in the on-screen sort, including a sort changed after an earlier export, without refreshing the page.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D9: “As-of label via the existing AsOfAnchorResolver (api/src/Reporting/Shared/Application/AsOf/), wrapped by a thin AgingAsOfResolver that supplies the workplace timezone and produces both formats: PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (M j, Y)”
  • Tech plan §3 D9, rationale: “Fixes the A/R PDF printing the next day's date (S3-R4).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
